mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies at the Verona Area High School with temperatures hitting 78 degrees and feeling like 85.

The Verona Senior Center is currently seeking volunteers. You can commit to two shifts a month helping with various programs. Remember that roles may involve light physical activity, and you will need to sign a confidentiality agreement to protect the privacy of our seniors.

There is plenty to do, starting with the Dane County Farmers Market today and various live music spots around town this evening. Looking ahead to tomorrow, check out the Cave Carnival at Cave of the Mounds or the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena.

On August 8, officers assisted the Dane County Sheriff's Office with a burglary in the Town of Christiana. By deploying a department drone, they successfully tracked a fleeing suspect who had attempted to hide in a corn field.
Today's flavor is the classic Turtle. It is a fantastic choice, and with Culver's open until 10:30 PM, you have plenty of time to stop by for a cold treat.
